The roots of \(g(x)=f(x+5)\) are the roots of \(f\) shifted left by \(5\).

For \(f(x)=x^3-49x^2+623x-2015\), the sum of its roots is

\[
49.
\]

Thus the sum of the roots of \(g\) is

\[
49-3\cdot 5=49-15=34.
\]

\[
\boxed{34}
\]
